def equation(x: np.ndarray, v: np.ndarray, params: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """ Mathematical function for acceleration in a damped nonlinear oscillator

    Args:
        x: A numpy array representing observations of current position.
        v: A numpy array representing observations of velocity.
        params: Array of numeric constants or parameters to be optimized

    Return:
        A numpy array representing acceleration as the result of applying the mathematical function to the inputs.
    """
    """ Mathematical function for acceleration in a damped nonlinear oscillator
    
    Args:
        x: A numpy array representing observations of current position.
        v: A numpy array representing observations of velocity.
        params: Array of numeric constants or parameters to be optimized
    
    Return:
        A numpy array representing acceleration as the result of applying the mathematical function to the inputs.
    """
    k = params[0]  # Stiffness
    c = params[1]  # Linear viscous damping
    d = params[2]  # Nonlinear damping
    d2 = params[3]  # Nonlinearity parameter
    zeta = params[4]  # Fractional damping parameter
    m = params[5]  # Mass of the oscillator
    f = params[6]  # Driving force
    
    # Fractional derivatives
    gamma = np.math.floor(zeta)  # Integer part
    delta = zeta - gamma
    if gamma > 0:
        d1 = np.polygamma(gamma, x)
        d1 = np.roll(d1, gamma)
    else:
        d1 = np.zeros(x.shape)
    
    # Non-integer part of fractional derivatives
    if delta > 0:
        d2 = np.polygamma(delta, x)
        d2 = np.roll(d2, -gamma)
        assert len(d2) == len(x)
